crossRefs.note: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.

translations.web: If he takes another wife to himself, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marital rights.
translations.bsb: If he takes another wife, he must not reduce the food, clothing, or marital rights of his first wife.
translations.kjv: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.
translations.asv: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.
